name: When should I consider repairing a door hinge versus replacing it entirely?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider repairing a door hinge versus replacing it entirely?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider repairing a door hinge if the damage is minor, such as loose screws, slight squeaking, or minor alignment issues. Simple repairs can often fix these problems, restoring function without the cost of a full replacement. However, if hinges are severely bent, rusted, cracked, or if the door frame itself is damaged beyond simple repair, a full replacement of the hinge or even the door and frame might be necessary. Assessing the extent of the damage helps determine the most cost-effective and lasting solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair minor hinge issues like loose screws or squeaks; replace if hinges are severely damaged, bent, or rusted.
